barriers.name: CAME
barriers.note: Partner for new vehicle barriers. CAME GARD booms, controls, loops and safety edges. Five-metre packs are on the products hub; installation is POA after survey.

barriers.name: BFT
barriers.note: Existing BFT barriers and gate operators. New lanes are normally specified on the CAME partner range unless the survey supports keeping BFT.

barriers.name: FAAC
barriers.note: FAAC barrier and operator servicing, including safety-device checks. New installs default to CAME unless the incumbent system should stay.

barriers.name: Nice
barriers.note: Nice barrier and gate automation. We identify the control board on site before quoting spares or a takeover.

barriers.name: Beninca
barriers.note: Beninca booms and operators. Service and fault work, with CAME specified when a lane is being replaced.

barriers.name: Magnetic Autocontrol
barriers.note: Magnetic Autocontrol barriers on car parks and staff entrances. We test loops, photocells and the boom before any control change.

barriers.name: Hormann
barriers.note: Hormann barriers and related door operators where they control a vehicle lane.

barriers.name: DEA
barriers.note: DEA System barrier and gate controls. Board and safety-edge checks before a quote.

barriers.name: Roger Technology
barriers.note: Roger Technology barriers and 24V operators. Useful where a brushless incumbent is still supportable.

barriers.name: Ditec
barriers.note: Ditec barriers and automation. Service of the existing lane, or a CAME replacement when the cabinet is no longer viable.

barriers.name: Tau
barriers.note: Tau barrier and gate gear. We confirm the model on the rating plate rather than guessing from the boom colour.

barriers.name: Cardin
barriers.note: Cardin operators on barriers and gates. Radio and loop faults are quoted separately from a full lane replacement.

barriers.name: Gibidi
barriers.note: Gibidi barrier motors and controls. Existing plant is serviced; new booms are CAME unless the site standard says otherwise.

barriers.name: Automatic Systems
barriers.note: Automatic Systems lanes used on busier car parks and controlled entrances.

barriers.name: Centurion
barriers.note: Centurion barrier and gate operators. We check torque and safety devices before adjusting force.

barriers.name: Elka
barriers.note: ELKA barriers. Cabinet, spring and loop checks on service visits.

barriers.name: Aprimatic
barriers.note: Aprimatic operators where they still run a barrier or sliding gate.

barriers.name: SEA
barriers.note: SEA barrier and gate controls. Model and board revision are recorded on the survey sheet.

barriers.name: Fadini
barriers.note: Fadini hydraulics and electromechanical barriers. Oil leaks and valve settings are part of the service, not an afterthought.

barriers.name: Key Automation
barriers.note: Key Automation boards and operators on barriers and gates.

barriers.name: LiftMaster
barriers.note: LiftMaster operators where a site already uses them on a vehicle entrance.

barriers.name: Genius
barriers.note: Genius barrier and gate operators, including older FAAC-group plant that is still in service.

barriers.name: Frontier Pitts
barriers.note: Frontier Pitts vehicle barriers and high-security lanes. We service the incumbent and specify CAME where a standard car-park boom is the right replacement.

barriers.name: Paxton
barriers.note: Paxton Net2 and related readers releasing a barrier. The barrier manufacturer and the access manufacturer are specified separately.

barriers.name: Videx
barriers.note: Videx panels and GSM modules used at a barrier or gate. Common on the 5m packs listed with CAME hardware.

barriers.name: HID Global
barriers.note: HID readers and credentials where a staff barrier must share the building access cards.

barriers.name: Comelit
barriers.note: Comelit video and audio entry when the barrier lane also needs a speech panel.

barriers.name: BPT
barriers.note: BPT entry panels tied to a vehicle gate or barrier release.
